model.architecture: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning hybrid Mamba-2-Transformer MoE with Parallel Expert Encoder (ASR + speaker), 34B total / 4.3B active
model.precision: BF16 (publisher checkpoint; FP8 and NVFP4 variants exist)

engine.name: vLLM + NeMo Speech plugin (nemo_speechlm)
engine.image_source: docker/Dockerfile (built locally; replicates the model card's uv-locked environment: torch 2.11.0+cu129, flashinfer 0.7.0.post1)
engine.note: No upstream digest exists for this stack; the Dockerfile is the pinned contract.

host.gpu: RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell DC-4-96Q, MIG 4g.96gb slice of GPU 0 (MIG-b12c2fdf-03dc-5a04-8cbb-46624a8df192)

scope.note: Single-slice screening only. The card's optimized NIM kernels are not in the open-source release; expect roughly half the published NIM RTFx.
